mapper.sql: r.id, r.run_no, r.conversation_id, c.conversation_no, r.parent_run_id, r.turn_no, r.user_id, r.user_name, r.entry_point, r.context_object_type, r.context_object_id, r.prompt_summary, r.status, r.error_code, r.error_message, r.started_time, r.completed_time, r.expires_time, r.create_time, r.create_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_run (run_no, conversation_id, parent_run_id, turn_no, user_id, user_name, entry_point, context_object_type, context_object_id, prompt_summary, status, error_code, error_message, started_time, completed_time, expires_time, create_time, create_by) VALUES (#{runNo}, #{conversationId}, #{parentRunId}, #{turnNo}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{entryPoint}, #{contextObjectType}, #{contextObjectId}, #{promptSummary}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedTime}, #{completedTime}, #{expiresTime}, #{createTime}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_run r LEFT JOIN t_ai_conversation c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM t_ai_run r LEFT JOIN t_ai_conversation c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.run_no = #{runNo}
SELECT FROM t_ai_run r LEFT JOIN t_ai_conversation c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY r.turn_no DESC, r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_ai_run r LEFT JOIN t_ai_conversation c ON c.id = r.conversation_id WHERE r.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY r.turn_no ASC, r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_run SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUNNING' AND started_time IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_time END, completed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_ai_run SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUNNING' AND started_time IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_time END, completed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END WHERE id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')
UPDATE t_ai_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'RUNNING')
